description: Same Node version, CPU, platform, architecture and GC mode required. Median of 7 samples after 3 warmups; allow 30% CPU/heap noise plus 1 MiB heap floor, 5% graph/production kernel gzip growth. Rebuild explicitly with --write-baseline; enforce with --check. Operation is a workload loop iteration, not an individual subscriber visit. Final calibration: three same-machine runs; absolute time ceilings are at most the original baseline ceilings. Historical report is retained as previousBaseline; batch is slower but remains within its unchanged original ceiling.
